description: This Java interface defines a repository for AssetProfileEntity objects, providing methods for querying asset profile data from a SQL database using Spring Data JPA. It includes custom queries for retrieving asset profile info, default profiles, and related entity info, with filtering and pagination support.

methods.name: findAssetProfileInfoById
methods.description: Retrieves AssetProfileInfo by asset profile ID.

methods.name: findAssetProfiles
methods.description: Finds paginated list of AssetProfileEntity filtered by tenant ID and optional text search.

methods.name: findAssetProfileInfos
methods.description: Finds paginated list of AssetProfileInfo filtered by tenant ID and optional text search.

methods.name: findByDefaultTrueAndTenantId
methods.description: Finds the default AssetProfileEntity for a given tenant.

methods.name: findDefaultAssetProfileInfo
methods.description: Retrieves default AssetProfileInfo for a tenant.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndName
methods.description: Finds AssetProfileEntity by tenant ID and profile name.

methods.name: getExternalIdById
methods.description: Retrieves external ID for an asset profile by ID.

methods.name: findByTenantAndImageLink
methods.description: Finds AssetProfileInfo list by tenant ID and image link with pagination.

methods.name: findByImageLink
methods.description: Finds AssetProfileInfo list by image link with pagination.

methods.name: findAllByImageNotNull
methods.description: Finds all AssetProfileEntity with non-null images, paginated.

methods.name: findActiveTenantAssetProfileNames
methods.description: Finds active asset profile names for a tenant.

methods.name: findAllTenantAssetProfileNames
methods.description: Finds all asset profile names for a tenant.

methods.name: findNextBatch
methods.description: Retrieves next batch of AssetProfileFields after a given ID.

methods.name: findAssetProfileInfosByTenantIdAndIdIn
methods.description: Finds AssetProfileInfo list by tenant ID and list of profile IDs.
